title: Fractal Universe
definition: The universe can be understood as a complex, interconnected network of patterns repeating at various scales.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a pattern that repeats itself at different sizes, like a snowflake. This concept suggests that our universe may follow similar patterns across various scales.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The fractal universe theory proposes that the universe exhibits self-similar patterns at different scales, providing a unified approach to understanding cosmic structure.
difficulty_levels.expert: Fractal universe theory posits that the universe's structure can be described as a complex, interconnected network of self-similar patterns repeating at various scales. This perspective challenges traditional notions of cosmic structure and offers a unique understanding of the universe's underlying organization.

extra_fields.insight: A novel understanding of the universe as a complex, interconnected network of patterns repeating at various scales.
